name: ONiO.zero
description: Wireless MCU integrating a radio and energy-harvesting power management.

pins.notes: The official feature overview does not supply a revision-specific package pinout; pin names and numbers remain unverified.

radio.notes: Official feature overview advertises Bluetooth LE 5.4 (1M, 2M, 125/500 kbit/s coded PHY), IEEE 802.15.4-2020 using 2.4 GHz O-QPSK, and programmable TX power from -40 to 0 dBm. The 250 kbit/s entry maps the declared 2.4 GHz O-QPSK PHY to its standard data rate. These are product-level capabilities, not revision-specific stack certification or characterized current/timing data. Do not substitute older ONiO.zero transmitter-only descriptions for this feature set.

simulation.scope: Catalog includes BLE and IEEE 802.15.4 capabilities. A runnable model needs qualified radio/CPU states plus the integrated harvesting, storage and power-management paths.
blockers: Obtain revision-specific datasheet and package pinout.
Characterize TX current versus output power, RX, CPU, sleep and radio/clock startup with supply and temperature conditions.
Model harvesting and storage, cold start, available-energy thresholds and brownout before predicting energy-limited radio traffic.
